candidate.answerReason: The 0 to 500 scale includes the maximum 410 and displays the differences effectively. The other scales are insufficient or unnecessarily large.

methods.label: Compare the proposed scales
methods.explanation: The maximum value is 410. A scale from 0 to 500 with 100 per division accommodates all the data and shows the differences between the values; the other 2 scales are too small or too large.
methods.levelReason: Comparing the data range with candidate axis scales is a Grade 7 chart-construction skill.

review.mathematicalCheck: The maximum is 410. A cannot accommodate any value; B accommodates all four and uses the axis effectively; C places all bars below the first 1000-unit division. B is the most suitable scale.
review.levelCheck: Comparing data ranges and axis scales is appropriate for Grade 7.
review.methodDistinctness: One direct comparison of the three options is sufficient.
review.annotationCheck: cnm_294 explicitly covers choosing vertical-axis scales. cnm_p054 supports comparisons involving the proposed ranges through 5000.
